以下為第3.23題
```{r}
# 1. 讀資料
collegetown <- read.csv("C:/Users/tiffa/Downloads/collegetown.csv")
head(collegetown)

# 2. 建立模型 PRICE = a1 + a2*SQFT^2
model_quad <- lm(price ~ I(sqft^2), data = collegetown)
res <- summary(model_quad)
# 抓參數
a2_hat <- coef(model_quad)["I(sqft^2)"]
se_a2 <- res$coefficients["I(sqft^2)", "Std. Error"]

# a. sqft = 20
# 邊際效應：ME = 2 * a2 * SQFT
# H0: 2 * a2 * 20 <= 13  => H0: a2 <= 13/40 = 0.325
sqft_a <- 20
t_stat_a <- (2 * a2_hat * sqft_a - 13) / (2 * sqft_a * se_a2)
p_value_a <- 1 - pt(t_stat_a, df = df.residual(model_quad))

# b. sqft = 40
# H0: 2 * a2 * 40 <= 13  => H0: a2 <= 13/80 = 0.1625
sqft_b <- 40
t_stat_b <- (2 * a2_hat * sqft_b - 13) / (2 * sqft_b * se_a2)
p_value_b <- 1 - pt(t_stat_b, df = df.residual(model_quad))

# a.b. results
print(res)
cat("(a) t-stat:", t_stat_a, "P-value:", p_value_a, "\n")
cat("(b) t-stat:", t_stat_b, "P-value:", p_value_b, "\n")

# c.預測 2000 呎房屋的價格與區間
# 建立一個sqft = 20的新資料
new_house <- data.frame(sqft = 20)

pred_c <- predict(model_quad, newdata = new_house, interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)
print(pred_c)

# d.計算樣本中 2000 呎房屋的實際平均售價
houses_2000 <- subset(collegetown, sqft == 20)
actual_mean_2000 <- mean(houses_2000$price)

# c.d. results
cat("2000呎實際房屋數量:", nrow(houses_2000), "\n")
cat("實際平均售價:", actual_mean_2000, "\n")
```

以下為第3.31題
```{r}
# 載入資料
library(PoEdata)
data("tuna")
head(tuna)

# a.
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Mean = colMeans(tuna[, c("sal1", "apr1")]),
  SD = sapply(tuna[, c("sal1", "apr1")], sd),
  Min = sapply(tuna[, c("sal1", "apr1")], min),
  Max = sapply(tuna[, c("sal1", "apr1")], max)
)
print(summary_stats)

# 畫時間序列圖
plot(1:52, tuna$sal1, type="l", main="Sales over Weeks", xlab="Week", ylab="Sales")
plot(1:52, tuna$apr1, type="l", main="Price over Weeks", xlab="Week", ylab="Price")

# b. 散佈圖
plot(tuna$apr1, tuna$sal1, main="Sales vs Price", xlab="Price (APR1)", ylab="Sales (SAL1)")

# c. 迴歸模型
tuna$price1 <- 100 * tuna$apr1
model_c <- lm(sal1 ~ price1, data = tuna)
summary(model_c)

# 95% CI
confint(model_c, "price1", level = 0.95)

# d. 預測價格為 70 美分時的銷售額
new_data <- data.frame(price1 = 70)
predict(model_c, new_data, interval = "confidence", level = 0.90)

# e. 計算平均值處的彈性
avg_p <- mean(tuna$price1)
avg_q <- mean(tuna$sal1)
b2 <- coef(model_c)["price1"]
elasticity <- b2 * (avg_p / avg_q)
cat("Elasticity at the means:", elasticity, "\n")
```
